big-query.title: One huge OR, or one array parameter
big-query.alt: Time to count rows matching a list of ids, for lists from 100 to a million ids. A query text built from OR clauses takes far longer to parse and plan as it grows. Passing the same ids as one array parameter stays much faster.

roles.title: Least privilege, tested
roles.hint: A role that can only insert. Each preset is a surprise from the course: read the error, then grant the missing right.

INSERT INTO todos (text) VALUES ('second');

presets.label: Grant the sequence
Try RETURNING
presets.sql:
SET ROLE dbcreate2;
INSERT INTO todos (text) VALUES ('third') RETURNING id;

presets.label: Can it read?
presets.sql:
SET ROLE dbcreate2;
SELECT * FROM todos;

presets.label: Who can do what
presets.sql:
RESET ROLE;
SELECT grantee, privilege_type FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_name = 'todos' AND grantee <> 'postgres';
